style: Illustrations originales peintes pour le projet, interprétations des profils ; aucun portrait officiel reproduit.
review: Les dix atlas ont été inspectés visuellement dans les sorties originales. Douze portraits indépendants par atlas, sans texte ni bordures. Les descripteurs corrigent certains attributs contradictoires du catalogue source en privilégiant les identités connues des épisodes. Plusieurs profils obscurs restent des interprétations de simulation.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production videogame PORTRAIT ATLAS, atlas 00. Create one exactly 2048 x 1536 pixel landscape image, a strict invisible grid of FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS: TWELVE independent 512 x 512 square portrait cells, row-major order. Every cell is a separate centered bust portrait from upper chest through COMPLETE HEAD including hats/helmets, not full-body figures. Each portrait occupies its own exact square only. NO panel borders, no gutters, no captions, no typography, no labels, no watermark. Do not invent a thirteenth face. Equal scale and consistent painterly rendering across all twelve cells. ALL BACKGROUNDS the SAME perfectly uniform matte dark navy black #101c24. Portrait silhouettes finish at bottom of their own cell, complete hair/hat silhouette fully within square with 8% headroom, face centered horizontally. High-quality painted realistic graphic-novel Metal Gear character art: nuanced faces, fine hair, tactile fabric and metal, mature gritty but elegant painting, amber soft key light upper left and cool blue rim right. NOT vector, not polygonal placeholder, not chibi, not pixel art, not photoreal celebrity photo. Identity and incarnation must be recognizable from canonical game design.
